calculate_cost_per_token: calculate perplexity API cost from model name and usage block with prompt and completion tokens
calculate_citation_token_cost: add citation token cost to prompt cost when citation_tokens and citation_cost_per_token are present in usage
calculate_reasoning_token_cost: add reasoning token cost to completion cost from reasoning_tokens or completion_tokens_details
calculate_search_query_cost: add web search request cost to completion cost using web_search_requests and search cost per query
use_pre_calculated_cost: use pre-calculated total_cost from usage.cost dict instead of manual token-based cost calculation
